2116328520615911922.a:
Recordings tab on a SDR records all traffic observed within the 8 MHz bandpass simultaneously. So missed calls. Unless the control channel is too far away. Then it recenters to capture voice calls on known channels while away from control. In hindsight you don't miss much that way.

(Standard disclaimer: Recording radio signals may be very illegal, or oddly very protected, in your jurisdiction. Sharing those recordings outside of News Reporting or educational purposes is almost certainly not legal. If you are in Florida you may wish to consult a lawyer before pressing record.)
